ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: the offering taken in the night
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: One night {PAWN_nameDef} took what had been left at a god's place, and everyone believed the god had taken it.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} about a night at the god's place, and what really happened to the offering.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said that {PAWN_nameDef} once took an offering in the night, and let everyone think it was the god.
